proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2757 kaphoṇi gives Prakrit kuhaṇī, Hindi kohni/kehunī, Bengali kanui and Western Pahari khunni “elbow”. The simple kohoni/kuhuni/khuni forms fit these contractions; no bāhu-containing compound is treated as a simple stem. The exact regional route may include borrowing between Indo-Aryan languages; the supported family is linked under the user’s preference.

Nearby kholi/khor forms can be linked provisionally to this defective-word family while the local extension and transmission remain open. The exact regional route may include borrowing between Indo-Aryan languages; the supported family is linked under the user’s preference.
